transcript.text: Before we go further, I need to raise a records retention concern. The district records schedule requires that the original student portfolios in this exhibition be stored in the district records archive for exactly 7 years. I confirmed this while reviewing the draft this week, but the exhibition paperwork hasn't been updated to reflect it. The current proposal to return or discard the original portfolios after the exhibition would put us out of compliance with that schedule.

transcript.text: I have a critical concern with the current draft. When I verified the consent forms for all six selected portfolios during this week's portfolio selection, I found that they permit public display only in a staffed indoor gallery, require student initials rather than full names on labels, and prohibit online publication. I have not yet transferred those restrictions into the draft plan, so the current proposal is out of compliance with the consent forms in three ways: the foyer display may not meet the staffed indoor gallery requirement, the plan uses full names instead of initials, and the online gallery is not permitted at all.
